title: Domix's Valentine Pack
description: Simple resource pack that changes Allays to little angels and Vexs to little devils.
body:
Simple Valentine themed resource pack that:
- Requires **[Optifine](https://www.optifine.net/home)** to work.
- Changes **Allay** model/texture to look like a little **Angel**
- Changes **Vex** model/texture to look like a little **Devil**
